message.content:
The editorial illustration shows a white magazine cover with a red vertical stripe on the left and a maroon border at the bottom. At the top, the large grey word "TEMPO" is centered above the date "10-16 NOVEMBER 2014". Three headlines sit above the title: "BUKTI BARU PEMBUNUHAN UDIN", "MENGAPA UKP4 DIBUBARKAN", and "BEREBUT BANDARA HALIM".

The central image features a large light-blue silhouette of a bird in profile, facing right. The bird’s open beak area reveals the head of a tiger with its mouth wide open, showing sharp white teeth, a pink tongue, and gums. The tiger head is rendered with white fur, black stripes, and orange highlights.

In the lower right, black text reads "KOMPLOTAN DI BALIK TRIOMACAN". Below this is a green icon, the word "Investigasi", a small square portrait of a man with glasses, and a paragraph starting "Siapa bohir dan pengguna jasa akun samaran itu?". It mentions "Raden Nuh". At the bottom left are a barcode, the price "RP 35.000", a website address, and an ISSN number.
